sentences.text:
The appellants'/claimants' agricultural land bearing Survey No. 211 and 210/2 admeasuring 1 Hectare 94 Are and Survey No.
210/209/4-C admeasuring 29 Are was acquired for the construction of Gondardi Percolation Tank pursuant to the notification issued and published under Section 4 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 dated 09.10.1984.
The possession of the acquired land was taken on 30.10.1987.
The Land Acquisition Officer passed an award on 25.10.1987 and awarded compensation of Rs. 9,700/- to the claimants for their acquired land.
The learned Reference Court enhanced the compensation and awarded Rs. 29,325/-.
However, the claimants have preferred the present appeal before this Court contending that the compensation awarded is meager.
It is also submitted that rental compensation has not been awarded though the possession of the land was taken in the year 1987.
5. Learned advocate for the appellants pointed out the pleadings, the evidence, the grounds of objections of the appeal and the reasons and findings in the impugned judgment.

He submitted that the sale exemplar dated 09.03.1984 of Mirajgaon wherein land admeasuring one acre in Survey No.53/2 was sold for a consideration of Rs.15,000/- was not properly appreciated by the learned Reference  2 of 6  (( 3 )) 903 FA NO. 898 OF 2003 Court while determining the market value of the acquired land.

The acquired land was earlier not irrigated, however, later a well was dug in survey No.210/1 after obtaining a loan from the bank which is corroborated by Exhibit-11,
the 7/12 extract of the acquired land.
The claimants' land was acquired after that.

However, the sale exemplar at Exhibit-22 is executed on 09.03.1984, therefore, the claimants are entitled to 10%
cumulative escalation for one year.
If 10% escalation of Rs. 1,500/- is added, the rate comes to Rs. 16,500/- per acre.
Thus, the claimants are entitled to compensation at the said rate.

In view of the judgment in Shankarrao Bhagwantrao patil VS. State of Maharashtra, (2022)
15 SCC 657, the claimants are entitled to rental compensation @ 9%
per annum on the compensation amount from the date of taking of possession of their acquired land till issuance of notice under Section  4 of 6  (( 5 )) 903 FA NO. 898 OF 2003 4 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894. The impugned judgment and award deserves to be set aside.
